title: Edit a family shot with care
description: Reduce noise and traces of damage, comparing the faces and the details with the original that was kept.

blocks.text: With an old family shot you want to reduce the damage and the noise while keeping the faces. Simply changing the exposure does not do the job, and details painted in can make a relative look like someone else.

quote.text: If you’re after photo preservation, do not download this app. It is unable to restore older photos. I’ve tried images from the 1980s-early 2000s and the results are hardly discernible from the original. You’ll typically notice an adjustment to the exposure and/or saturation but that’s the extent of it.

blocks.text: Carrying the edit through to a result

The original stays available next to the edited copy. The person applies individual kinds of correction, compares faces close up and undoes a patch that went wrong. For a family archive it helps to keep both versions.
Where the idea has an advantage

It is worth starting with one kind of damage, scratches for example. Restoring unknown details from any photo cannot be promised. If the result only looks sharper, that does not yet mean it has preserved the content better.
